bands.heading: #### Diagram: Pendulum Period Explorer
bands.objective: Learning objective (Bloom level: Apply; verb: predict): The learner will predict how the period of a pendulum changes when length changes, then test the prediction.
bands.body: Layout: drawing region above a control region; canvas 400 wide by 450 high. Controls: slider "Length" 0.2 to 2.0 in steps of 0.1, default 1.0; button "Release". Behavior: on release, the bob swings; a readout shows the measured period. Responsive design: canvas width follows the container on resize.
bands.implementation: Implementation: p5.js, createSlider and createButton positioned relative to drawHeight.

bands.heading: #### Diagram: Bounce Height Explainer
bands.objective: Learning objective (Bloom level: Understand): The learner will understand why a ball with lower bounciness reaches a lower height on its next bounce.
bands.body: Layout: drawing region above a control region; canvas 400 wide by 450 high. Controls: slider "Bounciness" 0.1 to 1.0 in steps of 0.05, default 0.7; button "Drop". Behavior: the ball falls and bounces; a readout shows the height of each bounce.
bands.implementation: Implementation: p5.js, createSlider and createButton positioned relative to drawHeight.

bands.heading: #### Diagram: Sine Wave Amplitude Lab
bands.objective: Learning objective (Bloom level: Understand; verb: explain): The learner will explain how amplitude and frequency change the graph of a sine wave.
bands.body: Layout: a plot above a control region. Controls: a slider for amplitude, a slider for frequency and a Reset button. Behavior: the curve redraws as either slider moves, and the equation above the plot updates.
bands.implementation: Implementation: Plotly.js with two HTML range inputs and a responsive plot div.

defects.text: Slider range not what I wanted: the slider runs from 1 to 100.
defects.explain: The body sets ranges, steps, defaults and sizes. When it gives no numbers, the agent has to invent them. Write the range, step and default into the Controls sentence.
defects.hint: Which band would hold numbers such as 0.2 to 2.0?

defects.text: The ball animates continuously, although the goal was for learners to explain each bounce.
defects.explain: Without a Bloom verb the design checkpoint cannot see that the task is to explain, so it has no reason to recommend a step-through. Write '(Bloom level: Understand; verb: explain)'.
defects.hint: The design checkpoint chooses the interaction pattern from one field.

defects.text: You asked for a p5.js simulation but received a Chart.js chart.
defects.explain: The Library field is the routing decision written down. If it is missing or wrong, the agent routes on keywords alone and may load the wrong guide.
defects.hint: Which field records the routing decision from Chapter 4?

defects.text: The batch run skipped this MicroSim: no folder was ever created.
defects.explain: extract-sim-specs.py finds blocks by a heading that begins '#### Diagram:' or '#### Drawing:'. A heading such as '### Diagram' or '#### Figure:' is never extracted.
defects.hint: How does the extraction script find a block in the first place?

defects.text: The chapter iframe points to one folder, but the MicroSim was generated in a folder with another name.
defects.explain: The sim-id becomes the folder name under docs/sims and the iframe path. It must match everywhere and be unique across the whole book.
defects.hint: Which field becomes the directory name?

defects.text: A new MicroSim was generated even though you planned to embed an existing one.
defects.explain: The status records the lifecycle state. A MicroSim you intend to reuse should be marked Reused so the batch run never scaffolds or implements it.
defects.hint: Which field tells the batch run what state this MicroSim is in?

defects.text: The buttons are drawn with rect() and mouse hit-testing instead of createButton().
defects.explain: The implementation line names the calls to use, such as createButton and createSlider positioned relative to drawHeight. Leave it vague and the agent may draw its own controls.
defects.hint: Which line names the library calls?

defects.text: You expected a MicroSim with controls but got a static labeled diagram.
defects.explain: The Type field names the kind of element to build. 'diagram' or 'infographic' invites a different build than 'microsim'.
defects.hint: Which field names the kind of element?
